_status: Reviewed and ready to render. Tracks are GENERATED, not recorded - tools/story-ambience/generate_music.py, one ElevenLabs Music request per track, prompts recorded in story-audio/music/prompts.json beside the rendered audio, same idiom as story-ambience/generate_sounds.py. Titles reviewed by the armenian-story-master agent 2026-09-11 (one fix applied: lullaby-melody's title was corrected from the non-standard Օրորային to Օրորոցային).

_rules.instrumentalOnly: Every prompt is instrumental music: no vocals, no lyrics, no singing, no spoken words. That instruction is appended in code (generate_music.py's build_prompt), not repeated in every prompt string here, so it cannot be dropped by an editing mistake.
_rules.noRealWork: Owner instruction: folk-flavoured where the prompt can say so, but never naming a real composer, performer, ensemble or existing piece. armenian-story-master flagged the closest miss on review: the word Օրոր alone is also the title of the best-known Armenian classical lullaby, so track 1 is named Օրորոցային մեղեդի (an adjective, "lullaby-like melody"), never the bare noun.
_rules.duration: 3 to 5 minutes each, matching tools/story-audio/check_music_audio.py's gate. Requested lengths are spread inside that window with margin on both ends (3:20-4:50) because the generator's actual output length is not guaranteed to land exactly on the request.
_rules.loudness: Post-processed to -23 LUFS in generate_music.py - see that script's docstring for why quieter than the -16.4 LUFS narration target. Never hand-levelled separately from the fade pass.
_rules.fades: 3s fade in, 8s fade out, applied in the same ffmpeg pass as the loudness normalisation. A bedtime track that starts or stops abruptly defeats the point of the feature.
_rules.prompt: tracks[].prompt is the reviewed English text sent to the generator. No field here is ever placement rationale (there is nothing to place - a whole-track loop, not a cue) so nothing needs the note/prompt split generate_sounds.py's cue sheet has.
_rules.licence: Every track's licence field states output ownership comes from the ElevenLabs plan's terms, not from the audio being synthetic - the same honest phrasing ambience-cues.json uses, not a claim that the question is settled.
